script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: “No trip back” asserts that Terah never returned to Ur. The text says he died in Haran but does not rule out a return trip.
“No map and no address” states details the passage does not give. It says God would show Abram the land.
“Sarai has no children yet” hints at what happens later in the story, which should not be given away.
“Only God can make a promise that size” is an exclusive claim the passage does not make.
